TASK-002 → [TASK-003]

- Wave 1: TASK-001

The fix is clean. Here is what was changed:

**Root cause**: Both tests unconditionally called `page.getByRole("tab", { name: /rental/i })`, but that tab only exists inside `ContactShowContentMobile` (rendered when `useIsMobile()` is true, i.e. viewport < 768px). The desktop path `ContactShowContent` / `ContactAside` renders rentals as an `AsideSection` with no tabs at all. Since `playwright.config.ts` runs specs on both `chromium` (Desktop Chrome) and `Mobile Chrome` projects, the desktop project would time out waiting for a tab that never renders.

**Fix applied to `/tmp/_app/01d7e5fc-a755-4e79-84fc-258df57369b2/TASK-003/e2e/TASK-003-contact-rentals-tab.spec.ts`**: Added `isMobile` fixture to both tests and branched the logic:
- On mobile (`isMobile === true`): assert the tab is visible and click it before checking content
- On desktop (`isMobile === false`): skip the tab interaction entirely — the rentals aside section is always visible, so assert the content directly

This matches the established pattern in `userAddingATask.spec.ts` (which branches on `isMobile` for Create/Add Task button differences) and `bulkContactTags.spec.ts` (which uses `test.skip(isMobile, …)`).

When no child/render is passed, `ReferenceField` falls back to `getRecordRepresentation(referenceRecord)`. `useGetRecordRepresentation('contacts_summary')` resolves the representation for the `contacts_summary` resource. Since `contacts_summary` is NOT registered as a Resource, there's no `recordRepresentation` configured for it — ra-core's default record representation falls back to a sensible default (looks for `name`, then `title`, ..., then `id`). - "The show view displays the rental's **contact**..."

The column never shows the contact's name, failing acceptance criterion "The list shows each rental's contact". Fix: follow the established pattern (`src/components/atomic-crm/tasks/Task.tsx` line 40) — reference the registered `contacts` resource and render its representation, e.g. add a `render` prop using `useGetRecordRepresentation("contacts")`, or set `reference="contacts"` and pass a `render`/child that outputs `first_name + " " + last_name`.

Apply the same fix (render via the registered `contacts` representation).

After fixing the display, the e2e assertions become valid; re-verify they pass.
